title: Lineage page must render registry graph and strategy tab must stop inventing nodes

delivered: Updated adaptLineageNode, adaptLineageEdge, and managementConsoleReads.lineage in src/lib/bff-v1/managementConsoleReads.ts so nodes are read from data.nodes/root.nodes (not root.items, which carries edges in /bff/lineage), edges are read from data.edges/root.edges/root.items with from/to/label mapping, adaptLineageNode preserves record.type ?? record.kind ?? record.artifact_type ?? record.entity_type ?? 'unknown' without defaulting missing types to 'Artifact' or fabricating risk, and page_info / has_more / meta.status are returned.

Updated LineageGraph in src/platform/components/LineageGraph.tsx to harden DAG BFS layering against cycles or missing endpoints and expose stable data-testid and data-* attributes on nodes, edges, and the empty state.

Updated LineageExplorerPage in src/management/pages/phase2/LineageExplorer.tsx to add Dataset to TYPES (Strategy, Persona, Artifact, CapitalPool, Experiment, Dataset), keep unknown node types visible and labelled when toggling known types, separate an unavailable lineage surface (data-testid='lineage-unavailable') from a real empty graph (data-testid='lineage-empty'), display a capped-graph notice (data-testid='lineage-has-more') when has_more is true, and reload managementConsoleReads.lineage(trimmedRootId) when entering a root id.

Updated StrategyDetail in src/management/pages/StrategyDetail.tsx so useLiveDetail fetches managementConsoleReads.lineage(entityId) with the strategy id as root and the Lineage tab renders the real registry lineage nodes and edges without fabricating alpha_src, CapitalPool/Persona nodes with constant deployed state or constant low/medium risk, or a dp_<id> '<id> → live' Deployment node, showing the empty lineage state when a strategy has no lineage.
Added bilingual i18n strings in src/i18n/locales/en-US.ts and src/i18n/locales/zh-TW.ts for lineageExplorer.unavailable and lineageExplorer.hasMore.

Added unit and component tests in src/lib/bff-v1/__tests__/managementConsoleReads.test.ts, src/management/pages/phase2/LineageExplorer.test.tsx, and src/management/pages/StrategyDetail.lineage.test.tsx using the real REGISTRY-LINEAGE-OWNER-READ-20261104 payload shapes (fd1281847a3b1c6a9735 corpus and strategy-persona-fd1281847a3b1c6a9735 root).
not_changed: Did not weaken, delete, or alter any existing test assertion across StrategyDetail.tradeJourneys.test.tsx, StrictLiveManagementSurfaces.test.tsx, fullOperationAssembly.test.tsx, managementConsoleReads.test.ts, or contract-drift.test.ts.
